replace_with_mxfp4_linear: replace expert layers in a torch model with mxfp4 quantized Mxfp4GptOssExperts modules
quantize_to_mxfp4: quantize a torch tensor to MXFP4 format using triton kernels with downcast and scale computation
convert_moe_packed_tensors: dequantize mxfp4 blocks and scales back to bfloat16 for forward pass compatibility
load_and_swizzle_mxfp4: load mxfp4 checkpoint weights and swizzle them into Mxfp4GptOssExperts module layout
routing_torch_dist: compute expert routing metadata with top-k selection gather and scatter indices for distributed MoE
